sparql:
PREFIX core: <https://example.org/dtwise/core/>
PREFIX ebom: <https://example.org/engineeringbom/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?engineeringId ?description ?assetIdentifier WHERE {
  GRAPH <https://example.org/dtwise/graph/ebom-v2> {
    ?equipment a core:BOMItemRecord .
    VALUES ?equipment { <https://example.org/dtwise/ebom-v2/item/EBOM-0002> }
    VALUES ?assembly { <https://example.org/dtwise/ebom-v2/assembly/ASM-CONDENSER> }
    ?equipment ebom:hasEngineeringLocalId "C-001" .
    ?assembly a core:AssemblyRecord .
    ?equipment core:hasRecordedParent ?assembly .
    ?association a core:FunctionalAssociation .
    ?association core:functionalAssociationTarget ?assembly .
    ?instrument a core:BOMItemRecord .
    ?association core:functionalAssociationSource ?instrument .
    ?instrument ebom:hasSourceDomain "DEXPI" .
    ?instrument ebom:hasSourceGroup "InstrumentationFunctions" .
    ?association core:sourceRecordId ?evidence_12 .
    ?association core:associationBasis ?evidence_13 .
    ?instrument ebom:hasEngineeringLocalId ?engineeringId .
    ?instrument ebom:hasItemDescription ?description .
    ?instrument ebom:hasAssetIdentifier ?assetIdentifier .
  }
}
ORDER BY ?engineeringId
